releaseNotes: v3.8.0: POSTER IMAGE FIX — All movie, series, and channel images now load correctly. Root cause was Coil 2.7.0 creating its own OkHttpClient using OkHttp 4.x API patterns which break against the OkHttp 5.0.0-alpha.14 classpath (NoSuchMethodError on removed APIs). Fix: Coil now uses the app's pre-built, working OkHttp 5 client via callFactory injection. Also added Coil ProGuard keep rules (prevented R8 stripping Coil's ServiceLoader factories in release builds) and a network_security_config.xml for reliable HTTP cleartext on all Android/FireOS devices. AsyncImage calls in Movies and Series screens now show proper dark fallback placeholders on load failure instead of transparent nothing.
